scr_ar_payment_summaries_list.purpose: Lists A/R payment summaries — groupings of customer payments by period or batch that post to the GL together — with status, totals and actions.
scr_ar_payment_summaries_list.outcome: Visibility of which customer payment batches are open, closed and posted.
scr_ar_payment_summaries_list.rootCause: Customer receipts post to the GL through payment summaries; month-end requires every payment summary for the period to be complete and closed so cash and receivables agree with the bank and aging.
scr_ar_payment_summaries_list.ifSkipped: Open payment summaries accept late receipts into reported periods and the cash-to-A/R tie-out breaks.
redFlags: Open payment summaries for prior months

scr_ar_creating_automatic_payment_summar.purpose: Workflow for configuring automatic payment summaries so customer receipts are grouped into period summaries without manual setup.
scr_ar_creating_automatic_payment_summar.outcome: Receipts consistently grouped by period for posting and close.
scr_ar_creating_automatic_payment_summar.rootCause: Manually created payment summaries are easy to misdate, sending a whole batch of receipts into the wrong month; automation removes that risk.
scr_ar_creating_automatic_payment_summar.ifSkipped: Receipt batches are misdated and cash is reported in the wrong period.

scr_ar_creating_a_payment_summary_manual.purpose: Creates a payment summary manually to group a specific set of customer receipts, for example a single large wire batch.
scr_ar_creating_a_payment_summary_manual.outcome: A defined batch of receipts ready to post.
scr_ar_creating_a_payment_summary_manual.rootCause: Some receipt batches need their own summary for traceability (e.g., a subsidy batch); manual creation must use the correct period date.
scr_ar_creating_a_payment_summary_manual.ifSkipped: Special receipt batches mix with routine receipts and are hard to trace.
redFlags: Manual summaries dated in the wrong period

scr_ar_editing_payment_summaries.purpose: Edits an open A/R payment summary's name, posting date or settings before it is closed, so the receipts it holds land in the intended accounting period.
scr_ar_editing_payment_summaries.outcome: Payment summary attributes corrected before posting is final.
scr_ar_editing_payment_summaries.rootCause: A payment summary dated incorrectly moves every receipt in it to the wrong period; editing while open fixes that cleanly.
scr_ar_editing_payment_summaries.ifSkipped: A misdated summary posts every receipt in it to the wrong month and breaks the bank rec.
redFlags: Date edits after the bank rec was finalized

scr_ar_deleting_a_payment_summary.purpose: Deletes an empty or erroneously created A/R payment summary so that stray batches cannot capture customer receipts in unintended periods.
scr_ar_deleting_a_payment_summary.rootCause: Stray empty summaries can capture receipts by mistake and confuse month-end reviews of receipt batches.
scr_ar_deleting_a_payment_summary.ifSkipped: Receipts land in stray summaries in unintended periods.

scr_ar_viewing_information_about_a_payme.purpose: Views a payment summary's details — period, status, total and the payments it contains.
scr_ar_viewing_information_about_a_payme.outcome: Understanding of one receipt batch and its GL posting.
scr_ar_viewing_information_about_a_payme.rootCause: When cash in A/R and cash in the bank rec disagree, investigating payment summaries shows which batch caused the difference.
scr_ar_viewing_information_about_a_payme.ifSkipped: Receipt batch differences cannot be traced.
redFlags: Summary totals not equal to deposits

scr_ar_payment_summary_information_page.purpose: The payment summary record page showing the summary name, posting date, open/closed status and receipt totals for one batch of customer payments.
scr_ar_payment_summary_information_page.outcome: A complete record of one batch of customer receipts.
scr_ar_payment_summary_information_page.rootCause: Summary status and totals evidence that the period's receipts are complete and locked for reporting.
scr_ar_payment_summary_information_page.ifSkipped: Evidence of receipt cutoff is incomplete at close.

scr_ar_transactions_list_of_payment_summ.purpose: Lists every customer payment included in a payment summary, with customer, reference, date and amount, supporting the batch total posted to 1130 Undeposited Funds.
scr_ar_transactions_list_of_payment_summ.outcome: The detail behind a receipt batch total.
scr_ar_transactions_list_of_payment_summ.rootCause: Tracing a GL cash posting back to individual customer receipts requires the summary's payment list.
scr_ar_transactions_list_of_payment_summ.ifSkipped: Cash postings cannot be traced to specific customer payments.
redFlags: Payments dated outside the summary period

scr_ar_viewing_the_payments_in_a_payment.purpose: Views the individual payments inside a payment summary to confirm the batch before closing.
scr_ar_viewing_the_payments_in_a_payment.outcome: Confidence that each receipt is in the right batch and period.
scr_ar_viewing_the_payments_in_a_payment.rootCause: Misdated receipts in a batch shift cash between months; reviewing before closing prevents that.
scr_ar_viewing_the_payments_in_a_payment.ifSkipped: Misdated receipts are locked into the wrong period.

scr_ar_adding_transactions_to_a_payment_.purpose: Adds received customer payments to an open payment summary so they post to the GL with that batch and inherit its accounting period.
scr_ar_adding_transactions_to_a_payment_.outcome: Payments grouped into the correct receipt batch.
scr_ar_adding_transactions_to_a_payment_.rootCause: Payments must belong to a summary to post; adding them to the right summary places them in the correct period.
scr_ar_adding_transactions_to_a_payment_.ifSkipped: Payments remain unposted or post to the wrong period.

scr_ar_reversing_a_payment_in_a_summary.purpose: Reverses one payment inside a payment summary — for example a returned check — without reversing the whole batch.
scr_ar_reversing_a_payment_in_a_summary.outcome: The returned payment is reinstated on the customer and the batch stays otherwise intact.
scr_ar_reversing_a_payment_in_a_summary.rootCause: Returned checks affect single payments; reversing only that payment keeps the rest of the batch matched to the bank deposit.
scr_ar_reversing_a_payment_in_a_summary.ifSkipped: Returned payments remain credited and A/R is understated.

scr_ar_applying_an_overpayment_an_invoic.purpose: Applies an overpayment sitting in a payment summary to another open invoice for the same customer.
scr_ar_applying_an_overpayment_an_invoic.outcome: Overpaid amounts consumed against open invoices.
scr_ar_applying_an_overpayment_an_invoic.rootCause: Overpayments left as unapplied credits overstate both receivables and customer credits; applying them clears both.
scr_ar_applying_an_overpayment_an_invoic.ifSkipped: Unapplied credits and open invoices both remain on the aging.

scr_ar_receive_payments_list.purpose: The Receive Payments list reached from a payment summary, showing payments available to add or apply within that batch.
scr_ar_receive_payments_list.outcome: Payments managed in the context of their batch.
scr_ar_receive_payments_list.rootCause: Working payments from their batch keeps application and period control together.
scr_ar_receive_payments_list.ifSkipped: Payments are applied without regard to their batch and period.

scr_ar_account_maintenance.purpose: Chapter on A/R account maintenance — penalties (late fees), printing or emailing invoices, and customer statements.
scr_ar_account_maintenance.outcome: Routine customer account upkeep performed consistently each month.
scr_ar_account_maintenance.rootCause: Collections depend on customers receiving invoices and statements and on late fees being applied per contract; account maintenance is where that routine lives.
scr_ar_account_maintenance.ifSkipped: Customers are not reminded of balances and late fees go uncharged.
redFlags: No statements sent to delinquent customers

scr_ar_about_the_account_maintenance_cha.purpose: Introduces the Account Maintenance options and when each is used in the monthly A/R cycle.
scr_ar_about_the_account_maintenance_cha.outcome: Users know which maintenance tasks to perform each month.
scr_ar_about_the_account_maintenance_cha.rootCause: Maintenance tasks are easy to skip under close pressure; a clear overview anchors them in the monthly routine.
scr_ar_about_the_account_maintenance_cha.ifSkipped: Statements and late fees are skipped in busy months.
redFlags: Maintenance tasks not on the monthly checklist

scr_ar_penalties_2.purpose: The Penalties menu option under Account Maintenance used to apply late fees to overdue customer invoices.
scr_ar_penalties_2.outcome: Late fees applied as part of monthly account maintenance.
scr_ar_penalties_2.rootCause: Applying penalties monthly, right after the grace period, keeps late fees consistent and defensible under lease terms.
scr_ar_penalties_2.ifSkipped: Late fees are missed or applied inconsistently and disputed.
redFlags: Late fees exceeding lease or state caps

scr_ar_print_or_email_a_r_invoices.purpose: Account Maintenance option to print or email posted A/R invoices in bulk — CAM reconciliations, bill-backs, ancillary charges — to customers' billing contacts.
scr_ar_print_or_email_a_r_invoices.outcome: All period invoices delivered to customers promptly.
scr_ar_print_or_email_a_r_invoices.rootCause: Invoices that are posted but never delivered do not get paid; bulk delivery ensures every customer receives their bill.
scr_ar_print_or_email_a_r_invoices.ifSkipped: Customers do not receive invoices and receivables age unnecessarily.

scr_ar_printing_or_emailing_a_r_invoices.purpose: Procedure for selecting invoices and printing or emailing them to customers' billing contacts.
scr_ar_printing_or_emailing_a_r_invoices.outcome: Invoices sent to the right contacts.
scr_ar_printing_or_emailing_a_r_invoices.rootCause: Sending to the correct billing contact (often a tenant's accounts-payable department) is what gets invoices into the customer's payment process.
scr_ar_printing_or_emailing_a_r_invoices.ifSkipped: Invoices go to the wrong people and sit unpaid.

scr_ar_print_or_email_statements.purpose: Account Maintenance option to print or email customer statements summarizing open invoices, payments and balance due.
scr_ar_print_or_email_statements.outcome: Customers receive a periodic summary of what they owe.
scr_ar_print_or_email_statements.rootCause: Statements prompt payment of forgotten invoices and surface disputes early, before balances become uncollectible.
scr_ar_print_or_email_statements.ifSkipped: Old invoices are forgotten by customers and become harder to collect.
redFlags: Statements not sent to customers over 60 days

scr_ar_statements.purpose: Explains customer statements (entity level required) — what they show and how they are generated.
scr_ar_statements.outcome: Users understand statement content and prerequisites.
scr_ar_statements.rootCause: Statements must be run at entity level so each customer's balance reflects the right entity's receivables.
scr_ar_statements.ifSkipped: Statements are run incorrectly or not at all.
redFlags: Statements generated at top level mixing entities

scr_ar_creating_statements.purpose: Generates customer statements as of a statement date for a selected set of customers, listing open invoices, unapplied credits and the aged balance due.
scr_ar_creating_statements.outcome: A batch of statements ready to print or email.
scr_ar_creating_statements.rootCause: Generating statements as of month-end gives customers a balance that agrees with the property's aging.
scr_ar_creating_statements.ifSkipped: Customers receive no statement or one that disagrees with the aging.
redFlags: Statement date not equal to month-end

scr_ar_selecting_statements_to_print_or_.purpose: Selects which customers' statements to print or email — for example only customers with balances over 30 days.
scr_ar_selecting_statements_to_print_or_.outcome: Statements sent to the customers who need them.
scr_ar_selecting_statements_to_print_or_.rootCause: Targeting statements at customers with balances focuses collection effort and avoids sending zero-balance statements.
scr_ar_selecting_statements_to_print_or_.ifSkipped: Statements go to everyone or to no one, diluting collection efforts.

scr_ar_when_to_print_statements.purpose: Guidance on when to print statements — typically after month-end close, once all payments and adjustments are posted.
scr_ar_when_to_print_statements.rootCause: Statements sent before all payments post show incorrect balances and trigger unnecessary disputes.
scr_ar_when_to_print_statements.ifSkipped: Customers receive statements showing amounts they already paid.

scr_ar_printing_statements.purpose: Prints customer statements for mailing to commercial tenants, housing agencies and other customers whose AP departments require paper statements.
scr_ar_printing_statements.outcome: Paper statements ready for customers who require mail.
scr_ar_printing_statements.rootCause: Some commercial tenants and agencies require mailed statements; printing supports those customers.
scr_ar_printing_statements.ifSkipped: Customers who require paper statements receive nothing.

scr_ar_emailing_statements.purpose: Emails customer statements as PDFs to each customer's billing contact, giving a faster, trackable delivery than mail for collection follow-up.
scr_ar_emailing_statements.rootCause: Email delivery is faster and trackable, speeding up collections from customers with electronic AP processes.
scr_ar_emailing_statements.ifSkipped: Statements are delayed and collections slow down.

scr_ar_sending_statements_to_multiple_em.purpose: Sends a customer's statement to several email addresses — for example the tenant's accounts-payable inbox and its property contact.
scr_ar_sending_statements_to_multiple_em.outcome: Statements reach everyone involved in the customer's payment process.
scr_ar_sending_statements_to_multiple_em.rootCause: Commercial tenants often route invoices through several people; copying all of them reduces 'we never received it' delays.
scr_ar_sending_statements_to_multiple_em.ifSkipped: Statements stall with one recipient and payment is delayed.
redFlags: Personal email addresses on corporate customers

scr_ar_print_email_statements_page.purpose: The page for setting statement options — date, customers, format — and printing or emailing them.
scr_ar_print_email_statements_page.rootCause: Consistent statement settings each month make balances comparable and reduce customer confusion.
scr_ar_print_email_statements_page.ifSkipped: Statement formats and dates vary month to month.

scr_ar_pex_import.purpose: PEX Import brings transactions from PEX — a platform managing employee expense cards, vendor payments and prepaid cards — into RealPage in batches.
scr_ar_pex_import.outcome: PEX card activity recorded in the books without manual keying.
scr_ar_pex_import.rootCause: Companies using PEX prepaid cards for site purchases need that spending in the GL with property coding; importing is the only practical way at volume.
scr_ar_pex_import.ifSkipped: PEX card spending is missing from the books or keyed manually with errors.
redFlags: PEX batches not reconciled to PEX statements

scr_ar_importing_pex_transactions.purpose: Imports a batch of PEX transactions for a date, creating the corresponding accounting entries.
scr_ar_importing_pex_transactions.outcome: A period's PEX activity loaded into RealPage.
scr_ar_importing_pex_transactions.rootCause: PEX card swipes happen daily at the site level; importing them by posting date is what places card spending in the correct accounting period and keeps petty cash reconciled to the PEX funding balance.
scr_ar_importing_pex_transactions.ifSkipped: PEX spending lands in the wrong period or is omitted.
redFlags: Duplicate imports of the same date range

scr_ar_pex_import_list.purpose: Lists every batch of transactions imported from PEX with posting date, transaction count and total, used to reconcile imports back to PEX's own activity reports.
scr_ar_pex_import_list.outcome: A record of every PEX import for reconciliation.
scr_ar_pex_import_list.rootCause: Each import batch must be reconciled to PEX's own records to confirm completeness and prevent duplicates.
scr_ar_pex_import_list.ifSkipped: Missing or duplicate PEX batches go unnoticed.

scr_ar_pex_import_box.purpose: Dialog for creating a PEX import batch and setting the date that imported transactions are posted.
scr_ar_pex_import_box.outcome: PEX batches posted to the intended date.
scr_ar_pex_import_box.rootCause: The posting date determines the accounting period of card spending; choosing it deliberately avoids period misstatement.
scr_ar_pex_import_box.ifSkipped: Card spending posts to the wrong period.

scr_ar_common_tasks.purpose: Supplemental A/R reference material on tasks common across applications, chiefly importing data.
scr_ar_common_tasks.outcome: A reference for less frequent A/R tasks.
scr_ar_common_tasks.rootCause: Imports and similar tasks happen rarely (onboarding, cleanups) so steps are not remembered; reference material prevents repeated errors.
scr_ar_common_tasks.ifSkipped: Rare tasks such as bulk imports are done inconsistently and produce data errors.

scr_ar_importing_data.purpose: Chapter on importing A/R data — customers, open invoices, adjustments and summaries — typically when onboarding a new property or management contract.
scr_ar_importing_data.outcome: A/R master data and opening balances loaded accurately at go-live.
scr_ar_importing_data.rootCause: Taking over management of a property means loading its customers and open receivables from the prior manager; errors at this stage carry into every future aging and collection.
scr_ar_importing_data.ifSkipped: Opening receivables are wrong and the subledger never ties to the acquired balance sheet.
redFlags: Opening A/R not tied to the acquisition balance sheet

scr_ar_overview_of_importing_data_into_r.purpose: Overview of RealPage imports — templates, file formats, validation and results — as used for A/R data.
scr_ar_overview_of_importing_data_into_r.outcome: Users understand the import mechanics before loading receivables.
scr_ar_overview_of_importing_data_into_r.rootCause: Understanding validation and error handling prevents partial loads where some customers or invoices silently fail.
scr_ar_overview_of_importing_data_into_r.ifSkipped: Partial imports go unnoticed and receivables are incomplete.
redFlags: Imports not checked against source totals

scr_ar_best_practices_for_preparing_data.purpose: Best practices for preparing A/R data for import — clean customer names, consistent IDs, correct dates, reconciled totals.
scr_ar_best_practices_for_preparing_data.outcome: Import files that load cleanly and tie to source records.
scr_ar_best_practices_for_preparing_data.rootCause: Most import problems are data problems in the source file; cleaning first avoids duplicates and rejected rows.
scr_ar_best_practices_for_preparing_data.ifSkipped: Imports produce duplicate customers and rejected invoices.
redFlags: Source totals not reconciled before import

scr_ar_downloading_a_template_from_the_i.purpose: Downloads the A/R import template (customers, invoices, adjustments) from Company > Import Data.
scr_ar_downloading_a_template_from_the_i.outcome: A correctly structured file to populate.
scr_ar_downloading_a_template_from_the_i.rootCause: Templates define required columns and order; using the current template avoids rejected loads.
scr_ar_downloading_a_template_from_the_i.ifSkipped: Imports fail on column layout mismatches and receivables data is not loaded.

scr_ar_filling_in_an_import_template_wit.purpose: Fills the A/R import template with customer or invoice data according to column rules.
scr_ar_filling_in_an_import_template_wit.outcome: A completed file ready for import.
scr_ar_filling_in_an_import_template_wit.rootCause: Codes (customer IDs, account numbers, locations) must exactly match system values or rows are rejected.
scr_ar_filling_in_an_import_template_wit.ifSkipped: Rows are rejected and data is incomplete.

scr_ar_preparing_your_csv_file_for_impor.purpose: Saves the A/R template as a clean CSV — no formulas, correct encoding, preserved leading zeros — ready for upload.
scr_ar_preparing_your_csv_file_for_impor.outcome: A file the importer reads correctly.
scr_ar_preparing_your_csv_file_for_impor.rootCause: Excel can silently alter data (dropping leading zeros from customer IDs, reformatting dates); proper CSV preparation prevents corrupted loads.
scr_ar_preparing_your_csv_file_for_impor.ifSkipped: Imported customer IDs and dates are silently corrupted and records mismatch.

scr_ar_about_csv_templates.purpose: Explains the types of CSV templates available for A/R imports and what each loads.
scr_ar_about_csv_templates.outcome: The right template chosen for each data type.
scr_ar_about_csv_templates.rootCause: Using the wrong template (e.g., adjustments instead of invoices) loads data into the wrong object.
scr_ar_about_csv_templates.ifSkipped: Data loads into the wrong record type, e.g. invoices loaded as adjustments.

scr_ar_order_of_csv_imports.purpose: Specifies the order in which A/R imports must be run — setup data and customers before invoices, invoices before payments and adjustments.
scr_ar_order_of_csv_imports.outcome: Dependent records load without reference errors.
scr_ar_order_of_csv_imports.rootCause: Invoices reference customers and accounts that must already exist; importing out of order causes widespread rejections.
scr_ar_order_of_csv_imports.ifSkipped: Imports fail because referenced records do not exist yet.

scr_ar_importing_a_csv_file.purpose: Uploads a prepared A/R CSV file (customers, invoices, adjustments or summaries), runs the import and reviews the results page for rejected rows.
scr_ar_importing_a_csv_file.outcome: Data loaded and import results available for review.
scr_ar_importing_a_csv_file.rootCause: Reviewing results after each import catches rejected rows before they are forgotten.
scr_ar_importing_a_csv_file.ifSkipped: Rejected rows are never corrected and opening receivables stay incomplete.

scr_ar_importing_offline.purpose: Runs large imports offline (in the background) and notifies the user when complete.
scr_ar_importing_offline.outcome: Large A/R loads complete without session timeouts.
scr_ar_importing_offline.rootCause: Portfolio onboarding files are large; offline processing avoids browser timeouts that can leave partial loads.
scr_ar_importing_offline.ifSkipped: Large imports time out and partially load.
redFlags: Offline imports not checked for completion

scr_ar_automating_imports.purpose: Automates recurring A/R imports — for example a nightly feed of ancillary revenue billings from an external system.
scr_ar_automating_imports.outcome: Recurring data flows in without manual uploads.
scr_ar_automating_imports.rootCause: External billing systems (utility billing, parking) produce data daily; automation keeps A/R current and avoids missed uploads.
scr_ar_automating_imports.ifSkipped: Recurring data is uploaded late or forgotten.

scr_ar_importing_customer_records.purpose: Imports customer master records in bulk — names, billing contacts, payment terms, customer types and default accounts — typically when onboarding a portfolio.
scr_ar_importing_customer_records.outcome: A full customer list loaded for billing.
scr_ar_importing_customer_records.rootCause: Onboarding a portfolio's commercial tenants and vendors one by one is slow and error-prone; importing ensures consistency.
scr_ar_importing_customer_records.ifSkipped: Customers are keyed inconsistently and duplicates appear.
